abstract: Semen for cryopreservation was collected in a man with a testicular teratoma after unilateral orchidectomy but before chemotherapy which rendered him azoospermic. After two years artificial insemination using this semen in his wife failed repeatedly. The semen quality on thawing was extremely poor in terms of sperm motility. A pre-freeze motility of 90 per cent was reduced to 2 per cent, and the movement was graded as sluggish. Using the techniques of semen and oocyte preparation and in vitro fertilization, a number of cleaving embryos was produced. A pregnancy was established after four of these embryos were replaced in the wife. The pregnancy aborted spontaneously, but a subsequent course of treatment resulted in an on-going twin pregnancy. The potential of in vitro fertilization for overcoming the poor quality of semen after storage by cryopreservation from men with testicular neoplasms is discussed.
abstract_ja: 精巣奇形腫を伴う男性の片側精巣摘除後、化学療法で無精子症となる前に精液を凍結保存した。2年後、凍結精液を用いた人工授精を妻に行ったが繰り返し失敗した。解凍後の精子の質は極めて不良で、融解前の運動率90%が2%に低下し、運動は緩慢であった。精子および卵子の調製と体外受精の手技を用いて、多数の分裂胚が得られた。このうち4個の胚を妻の子宮に移植した後に妊娠が成立した。妊娠は自然流産したが、その後の治療により双胎妊娠が継続している。精巣腫瘍を有する男性における凍結保存後の精液の質の低下を、体外受精で克服できる可能性について考察する。
